1.2.0: Set up a stable computer copy with Desktop and Start or Applications menu shortcuts.
Faster Windows launches from the computer copy after the first setup.
Verify signed USB updates and preserve your existing local profiles, settings and browser downloads.
Find version details, release notes and pinning guidance in App & updates.
Refreshed application icon across the launcher, desktop and taskbar.
1.3.0: Check, download, verify, and restart with online updates from App & updates.
Public Windows and Linux downloads with signed release metadata and SHA-256 checksums.
Keep local profiles and proxy credentials on each device.
Protected release uploads and atomic publishing with GitHub Actions deployment.
Consistent browser branding across desktop, shortcuts, and the download website.
1.4.0: Choose the proxy provider for each profile and launch; provider keys are stored per device in the encrypted vault, and existing keys move over automatically (a backup of the previous vault is kept).
Site access tokens: send a secret header only to your own listed sites so your WAF or CAPTCHA can allow QA traffic.
Self-healing selectors: recorded steps keep backup locators, healed steps are flagged in results, and one click updates the scenario.
Headless runner as a Docker image and a reusable GitHub Action for CI.
Now open source under the Apache License 2.0. Desktop and menu shortcuts are updated automatically; on Windows, unpin and re-pin a taskbar pin once if it opens a second taskbar button.
